story_type: carrier catapult dead-load test, weighted sled flung off the bow into a river
hook: They launched a 7,900 pound sled off a carrier.
narration: They launched a seven thousand nine hundred pound sled off the bow of an aircraft carrier.
This was a dead load test of the new catapult on Gerald R. Ford, before the carrier was commissioned.
Instead of steam, this catapult uses electric motors.
[short pause] Then it shot down the deck and off the bow.
It came down in the James River.
outcome: The sled was recovered from the river for more test launches.
title: Carrier catapult flings a sled overboard
description:
In June 2015, sailors, civilian employees and contractors watched a dead-load test of the electromagnetic aircraft launching system (EMALS) aboard Pre-Commissioning Unit Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78). The weighted sled was launched into the James River and recovered for more test launches.
